240-4460-5470-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-4460-5470-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

141-1893-6798.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1893-6798.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-2443-2841-3534.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-3534.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
1479-2443-2841-3534.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Field of the Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-4681-4894-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

967-5220-6798-7855--180.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Goblin, Orc or Army.
967-5220-6798-7855--180.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat

813-3617-7370.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Scholar of the Ages.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Scholar of the Ages from exile to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

206-2033-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
206-2033-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
206-2033-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1786-6980-7737.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1786-6980-7737.description:
Draw a card.
Queza and Stark's Ingenuity trigger for each card drawn.
Resolve all Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life for each trigger.
Resolve the first Stark's Ingenuity trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fetid Gargantua.
Fetid Gargantua triggers, causing you to draw two cards and lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.
1786-6980-7737.notes: With the additional Stark's Ingenuity trigger, you can target any creature you control to put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1170-1329-1492-5434.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-5434.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3536-4499-7494.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker.
When Cheering Fanatic attacks, it triggers, allowing you to name Seething Song and reduce the cost of spells with that name by {1} this turn.
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat from step 3.

3470-3875-5856-7514.description:
Activate a Food using Dawntreader Elk's ability by paying {G} and sacrificing it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Lotus Cobra and Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Food token and adding {G}.
Repeat.

372-4823-7339.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-4823-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Timeless Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Timeless Witness trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Timeless Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6633-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6633-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-628-2193.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Chainbreaker.
When Chainbreaker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Chainbreaker enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

147-1269-2511.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1269-2511.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2060-4518-5060-6930.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

618-3991-6798.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token.
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3473-3629.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 20 or higher.
3473-3629.description:
Cast Transcendence by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}.
Transcendence triggers due to you having 20 or more life. However, you cannot lose the game due to the creature with Cloudsteel Kirin attached.
Step 2 repeats in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.
3473-3629.notes: Note that if Cloudsteel Kirin or the creature it is attached to is removed from the battlefield, you will lose the game due to Transcendence's effect.

913-3586-4222.description:
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by tapping it, adding {2} and causing you to copy the next ability you activate or spell you cast that has {X} in its cost.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Magus Lucea Kane.
Repeat.
Once you have a large number of delayed triggers, cast a spell or activate an ability with {X} in its cost to have Magus Lucea Kane copy that spell or ability infinitely.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-617-1283.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Chromatic Orrery.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.

643-4508-6310.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
643-4508-6310.description:
Activate Shao Jun by tapping two artifacts, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Repeat.
643-4508-6310.notes: Once you have one opponent remaining, the loop fails to create enough Treasures to sustain itself. You may use other artifacts as desired or wait another turn until your artifacts are untapped. If you have more than two opponents, this combo will net Treasure(s) per loop, and those can also be used once you only have one opponent remaining.

560-2921-4550-4616.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2921-4550-4616.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Moldervine Reclamation triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards and gain 2 life.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Repeat.

1558-1744-5382.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other artifacts.
1558-1744-5382.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Illustrious Wanderglyph.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, ensuring to keep at least five Illustrious Wanderglyphs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
During your upkeep, each Illustrious Wanderglyph you control triggers, creating that many 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

1887-2763-3663.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least three loyalty counters on it.
1887-2763-3663.description:
Activate Kaya's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, exiling Three Blind Mice and creating a token copy of it that is a 1/1 Soldiers in addition to its other types.
The Three Blind Mice token enters the battlefield with two lore counters on it due to Vorinclex, triggering its first and second chapter abilities.
Resolve the first Three Blind Mice trigger, creating a 1/1 Mouse creature token.
Resolve the next Three Blind Mice trigger, creating a token copy of the Three Blind Mice token.
Repeat from step 2.

405-1308-2232-4050.description:
Cast Resolute Reinforcements by paying {1}{W}.
When Resolute Reinforcements enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Resolute Reinforcements trigger, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Resolute Reinforcements to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Soldiers, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.
